'''Golden flash''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] used in [[45 ABY]] by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Fire/Legends|burn]] their enemies to ashes.

==Description==
Golden flash was a [[Force power/Legends|Force Power]] used to summon a blast of [[Color/Legends|golden]] Force energy to burn an enemy to ashes. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] spontaneously used this power while fighting [[Craitheus Qreph]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] to launch a blast of yellow fire that, when combined with her brother's use a [[Time/Legends|half second]] later, burned the Qrephs to ashes, [[Death/Legends|killing]] them and exiling the shadows that were empowering them. The backlash of the attack of the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] meeting rebounded and appeared to annihilate Solo and Skywalker, though in fact they were recalled by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] speaking Leia Organa Solo's name (though her body and mind appeared to be reset to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] until Han Solo explained her life, whereupon she remembered it all and aged to her proper state), then she recalled her brother when she said his name. Being subjected to the backlash of his own attack also granted Skywalker new insights into the nature of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="CRU" />

==History==
When pursuing [[Craitheus Qreph]], [[Marvid Qreph]], and [[Savara Two]] into the realm accessed via the [[Unidentified monolith]], Solo and her brother [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] found that the only way to [[Death/Legends|slay]] their enemies was by using the Force to utterly destroy their bodies, as shown with [[Savara Two]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] spontaneously discovered and used this power while fighting [[Craitheus Qreph]] and [[Marvid Qreph]].<ref name="CRU" />
